source_text: Congregati cum senioribus consilium acceperunt ut darent pecuniam militibus, ut dicerent: Discipuli eius nocte furati sunt eum, dormientibus nobis. Qui legebant Non falsum testimonium dices alios ad falsum testimonium invitabant. Gloria Christo resurgenti. Amen.
pass_a_gloss: Having-gathered with elders counsel they-took that they-might-give money to soldiers, that they-might-say: Disciples of-him by-night stole him, with-us sleeping. Who were-reading You-shall-not false witness say others toward false witness were-inviting. Glory to Christ rising. Amen.
pass_b_english: Gathered with the elders they took counsel to [[give money to the soldiers to say: His disciples stole him by night while we slept >> Bible:Matthew 28:12-13]]. Those who read [[You shall not bear false witness >> Bible:Exodus 20:16]] invited others into false witness. Glory to Christ rising. Amen.
notes: Melito skipped; never Cyril Matthew densify.
